combinations.component: Kanban list display (column menu on a card)
combinations.interaction: show a list as Kanban and move a card to another column through its dependency dialog
combinations.task: Give the SF UI Probe {{probeId}} the Kind Fruit, open the Kanban Probes list view, show it as Kanban, move the card "{{probeName}}" from the Fruit column to the Tool column, and confirm its stored Kind is Tool.
combinations.notes: the list view keeps only replay probes with a Kind, so the route gives its probe one first. The Kanban display is not kept across sessions, so the route switches to it each time; the card's "Change column for <name>." button opens a menu of the other columns (no aria-controls, so sf_click returns no opened), which moves it without a drag; Kind controls the dependent Detail, so the move opens an Edit Dependencies dialog and saves only on Done. A user switching a list to Kanban the first time gets a Kanban Settings dialog (Group By Kind, Save), saved per user: a rebuilt fixture org needs that once before this route replays
